description: Repeated-workload resource and timing records for the first release (robustness package E, task 3). Release builds only; no pass/fail budget exists: comparisons are emitted as 'unreviewed' until a maintainer reviews baseline evidence.
comparison_policy: like-for-like (workload, inputs, build configuration, compiler, host class) only; otherwise incomparable; never an automatic pass

workloads.description: First map open: one process start, MPQ open, palette/tile load, headless render at 1:4 and exit. Each cycle is a fresh process, so the first cycle is also recorded as a separate cold-start sample.
Authored DCC fixture decoded by the production dcc.c through the reference probe. Process start dominates; this tracks decoder regressions on a portable input, not real-asset throughput.
Authored DC6 fixture decoded by the production dc6 path through the reference probe.
Real DT1 (ACT1 town floor.dt1) decoded and exported to per-tile PNGs by the editor CLI.
Real DCC (NEHDBHMWLHTH) decoded and exported frame by frame by the editor CLI.
Layered character composition and APNG export of one direction (NE/WL/HTH).

workloads.reason: Switching between a declared pair of maps inside one editor session needs an in-process repeat mode; the headless CLI opens one map per process. Until one exists, in-session growth across map switches is not observed and must not be inferred from the per-process runs above.
